name: firefox-inspect-mcp
description: Inspect a web page's DOM, console, network and storage through a separate, throwaway Firefox
long_description:
A local MCP server written in Swift that lets Claude look at a web page the way the browser's inspector does.

It starts its own headless Firefox with an empty temporary profile, deleted when the server stops. It is not your everyday browser: it cannot see your tabs, logins, cookies or history, and pages that need a login show their logged-out state.

Tools: open_url, page_elements, console_messages, network_requests, network_response_body, page_storage, page_screenshot, firefox_status. There is no tool that runs caller-supplied JavaScript. Sources, timelines, memory and breakpoints are not available.

Requires Firefox at /Applications/Firefox.app, or set its path below. No telemetry; logs carry fixed events only.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Mozilla.

tools.name: firefox_status
tools.description: Reports whether Firefox is installed where this server expects it and whether the browser it controls is running. Starts nothing.

tools.name: open_url
tools.description: Loads an http or https page in the throwaway Firefox this server controls, starting it first if needed. Clears console and network history.

tools.name: page_elements
tools.description: Returns the HTML of the first element matching a CSS selector, as the browser holds it after scripts have run, plus the match count.

tools.name: console_messages
tools.description: Returns console output and uncaught JavaScript errors from the loaded page since the last open_url.

tools.name: network_requests
tools.description: Lists the requests the loaded page made: method, URL, status, type, size and duration; headers on request.

tools.name: network_response_body
tools.description: Returns the body of one request from network_requests. Binary bodies come back as base64.

tools.name: page_storage
tools.description: Returns cookies (HttpOnly included), localStorage and sessionStorage of the throwaway browser.

tools.name: page_screenshot
tools.description: Returns a PNG of the loaded page's viewport.

firefox_path.title: Firefox executable (optional)
firefox_path.description: Leave empty to use /Applications/Firefox.app. Otherwise the full path to the executable inside the app bundle, e.g. /Applications/Firefox Nightly.app/Contents/MacOS/firefox.
